correctness.rationale: The isolated orbit exhausts X\X' and converges in k residue phases by the source lemma. Direct commutation propagates the first m images along each sampled ray. Continuity at each p_j is equivalent to phase offsets agreeing for equal classes modulo gcd(k,m). Surjectivity requires a permutation of the first m orbit points; the permutation congruence forces independent within-residue permutations and a top S_d factor. The coprimality gcd(m/d,k/d)=1 supplies the exact wreath formula. Finite exhaustive checker agrees for m<=7,k<=10 but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The automorphism group of a time-sampled system is a natural invariant of dynamical symmetry. The classification shows precise finite wreath-product groups for the entire rank-two dense-orbit class, including a trivial f-centralizer becoming S_k at sampling by f^k; classification also covers all continuous noninvertible commuting maps. The result is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputation of an existing list.
